summary: Cheatsheet examples for ansible-doc: `-F` shows plugin names with their source files and `-t module -l` lists available modules.
questions: How do I list all modules available on my control node?
How can I find which file a plugin is loaded from?
What ansible-doc option lists plugins of a given type?

answer_card.title: List plugins with ansible-doc
answer_card.answer_md:
- Plugin names and source files: `ansible-doc -F`
- List available modules: `ansible-doc -t module -l` (change `-t` for other plugin types)
